Mia: ugh. which failures look flaky vs real?

Omar: opening the failing job logs now. first glance looks like a network timeout 504 from the payments-mock service. Might be infra.

Jen: our change in this release touched the payment client headers — could be related. any stack traces?

ci-bot: excerpt:
```
E           AssertionError: Expected status 200 but got 504
redwood.payments.client.PaymentError: ServiceUnavailable
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "payment_flow_test.py", line 128, in test_retry_on_network_error
    resp = client.charge(...)
```

Alex: I can rerun just that job. If it's an infra flake the rerun should clear. Recommend: rerun job -> if fails again, rollback pin to `v1.7.9` and abort this window.

Mia: +1 to rerun. If second run fails we should abort and open a postmortem. We shouldn't force-override to prod.

Omar: rerun triggered: `ci-bot rerun job 7821 --owner Omar`

ci-bot: rerun started (job 7821.2). ETA ~7m.

deploy-bot: Deploy is blocked by CI gate. Current status: blocked waiting on gate resolution. No partial rollout.

(ci-bot posted an update)
ci-bot: rerun completed: job #7821.2 — FAILED (9 failed, 37 passed)
New failures include same `payment_flow_test` and one additional timeout in `refunds` scenario.

Jen: that's worrying. failing deterministically now. Could be our header change. Mia can you revert client change in a patch and run unit/integration locally?

Mia: on it. I'll reproduce locally and open quick revert PR if root cause points to our change. Estimated 30–45m.

Alex: In parallel I'll provision a canary environment and run the failing integration against a stable mock to verify flake vs code.

Omar: Should we pin prod to `v1.7.9` and abort the current deploy? What's current live tag?

Jen: live is `v1.7.9`. Yes, pin and abort this attempt. We have a change window but we must keep prod safe. Mia, if revert is small we can queue a hotfix release after tests pass.

Mia: creating revert PR now: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/PR/4521 — includes tests updated. Running CI on PR.

ci-bot: PR check triggered (PR 4521). Running unit tests + integration subset.

deploy-bot: Action required: deploy blocked due to failing CI gate. Manual decision recorded: abort_current_deploy = true, pin_to_tag = v1.7.9.

Omar: I'll update the release notes and notify on-call. Also scheduling a 30m postmortem sync at 2026-03-20T10:00Z to triage root cause.

Jen: thanks all. Revert PR green -> we'll re-open new deploy. For now, keeping prod pinned to v1.7.9 and closing this deploy thread. :lock:
